In this 5-second visual, Salim Vastik is seen on the bed. He has oxygen attached, and stitches are visible on his throat. The doctor says - Salim... He (Salim) opens his eyes and looks. The doctor says - Stick out your tongue... Salim sticks out his tongue. The doctor says - Good. The family has been informed that Salim's condition is much better after the operation, and the medicines are continuously showing effect. On the other hand, the father of Zeeshan and Gulfam from Amroha, who attacked Salim, says - My sons were encountered, and that too was fake. If they made a mistake, they should have been arrested and taken to court. I don't have the means to go to the Supreme Court. Police have not yet been able to clarify who the real mastermind behind the attack on Salim Wastik is? This is why the police are questioning everyone who was in contact with Zeeshan and Gulfam. Now read what Salim's son says about his health... Son said - Dad is reacting, whether he will be able to speak or not, is unknown. Let us tell you that YouTuber Salim Wastik is undergoing treatment at Max Hospital in Delhi. He is currently in the ICU. Salim's son Usman and relatives are present at the hospital. Usman says - Earlier, his father's condition remained serious at GTB Hospital and now at Max Hospital. He was not conscious until now. Today, March 5, he regained consciousness for the first time since the attack on February 27. We are not allowed to go inside. The doctor said that Salim is able to react to sounds but is not yet in a condition to speak. Whether he will be able to speak later or not, the doctor has not clarified yet. Doctors are also saying that the medicines are showing an effect. His condition is continuously improving. Efforts are also underway to recover the liver damage caused by the knife wound with medicines. However, the doctor also said that the wounds are very deep and it may take a long time to fully recover. Wife shifted to a safe place, police van outside the hospital Salim Wastik had kept his wife and son away from himself in Ashok Vihar (Delhi). Where do they live in Ashok Vihar? Police are not disclosing this due to security reasons. The wife has been shifted by the police to a safe place. Son Usman has also been given local police numbers to call for help if he feels any danger. A QRT police van has also been stationed outside Max Hospital in Delhi. Ghaziabad police officers are in contact with the doctors at Max Hospital. Waiting for help for Salim's treatment expenses According to Salim Vastik's family, the entire treatment of Salim Vastik is estimated to cost ₹50 lakh. So far, the expenses have been covered by the savings and the help sent by people. On March 5, Pinky Chaudhary, the national president of Hindu Raksha Dal, also reached Max Hospital. He said, the entire Hindu society stands with Salim. So far, we have provided help worth 4-5 lakh rupees. The entire treatment is expected to cost ₹50 lakh. For security, we are keeping an eye around the hospital. When Salim recovers, we will keep him with us. We will not let him go home. Father's anger in Amroha Said - I am not a beggar, I will earn myself, I will raise my grandson Meanwhile, after the encounter of the two brothers, Zeeshan and Gulfam, in Amroha, their father, Buniyad Ali's anger also came to the fore. He said - If my sons were guilty, they should have been arrested and presented in court. What is this, that they were encountered? That too, fake... We have no demands from our government; we are not beggars. I have two grandsons now, and I will earn in the future, and feed them. Where will I go now? I don't have the means to go to the Supreme Court for justice. He says - Zeeshan was the youngest. He was not married. He was fond of making religious videos and poetry. I am not educated enough to know what is wrong with that. Know Zeeshan and Gulfam, who attacked Salim Gulfam. Zeeshan. Now watch the CCTV footage of the attack on Salim Pakistani YouTuber incited the attack Zeeshan ran a YouTube channel. At the behest of a Pakistani YouTuber, Zeeshan, along with his brother, launched a deadly attack on Salim. Both brothers were connected to a radical organisation's Telegram group. This group has 18,200 members. Admitted on Telegram group - Salim sent to hospital After the attack on Salim, a photo of Salim was posted on the Telegram group with the caption: Salim Ex-Muslim has been sent to the hospital, want video? After this, CM Yogi had given instructions to teach a lesson. The police had announced a reward of ₹1-1 lakh for Zeeshan and Gulfam. Both have been encountered. Came from Amroha on February 17, started keeping an eye on Salim from the 18th In the case of the deadly attack on Salim Wastik, important information has come into the hands of the investigation agencies. Zeeshan and Gulfam had been keeping an eye on Salim's movements for the last 10 days, i.e., since February 18. During this time, he attempted to attack 3 times, but failed every time. Because each time, someone or the other was sitting in his office with Salim. Therefore, he could not attack. On February 27, when Salim returned after offering prayers and was alone in the office, Zeeshan and Gulfam succeeded in their intentions. Met family on 17th, posted video Not only this, Zeeshan knew beforehand what could happen to him after the attack, so he left the village on February 17 after meeting his parents for the last time, and on this day, he made his last video and uploaded it to his Instagram account. In this video, he is seen sitting in an auto, with ghazal lines playing in the background. Keep your passion ready for the journey, be unaware but know everything, who knows when you have to depart, keep your belongings brief. From the next day, i.e., February 18, Zeeshan and Gulfam started keeping an eye on Salim's movements. Gulpham was identified by his round cap ADCP Piyush Kumar Singh said - a .32 bore pistol, 2 cartridges, a KTM bike without a number plate, a mobile phone, an Aadhaar card, a driving license, and a backpack were recovered from Gulpham. He said that Gulpham, wearing a round cap, matched the CCTV footage. A sweater, another round cap, a jacket, and a mobile charger were found in his bag. On February 27, both brothers attacked Salim Wastik with a knife. Salim defended himself with an iron rod. During this, Gulpham's right hand was injured, and Gulpham got treated at a hospital in Gurugram. Stitches were found on his right hand. Police investigation revealed that the bike used at the time of the attack belonged to Zeeshan's maternal uncle, Rashid, which Zeeshan himself used to ride. Read the story of Zeeshan and Gulfam's encounter in 2 points DCP Piyush Singh said- On Sunday night, Loni Police Station in-charge Nitin Chaudhary and the rural SWAT team saw 2 suspects coming on a bike. When they tried to stop them, both fired at the police with pistols. About 25 to 30 rounds of firing took place for about 15 minutes. One bullet hit the criminal. During interrogation, he revealed that he had attacked Salim. His absconding accomplice is his elder brother, Gulfam. The police took the injured Zeeshan to the hospital. There, doctors declared him dead. 48 hours later, information was received that Gulfam was in the Indirapuram police station area. A cordon was set up in front of Vasundhara Power House. At night, a bike was seen approaching. Two people were riding on the bike. When asked to stop, the bike turned to the right. The SWAT team pursued. Due to a mound of earth, the criminals' bike skidded, and they fell. Seeing the police approach, they started firing. In retaliatory firing, a bullet hit Gulfam. Injured Gulfam was sent to the hospital, where doctors declared him dead. YouTuber Salim Ahmed alias Salim Wastik (50) lives with his family in Ashok Vihar Colony, Delhi. He has another house in the Loni area of Ghaziabad. Salim runs his office from there. His son Usman said that his father was sitting alone in the office at 9 am on February 27. Then 2 youths wearing helmets came and attacked him. As soon as they entered, they stabbed him repeatedly. Usman said - his father fell to the ground injured. Blood started flowing from his body. Meanwhile, both the assailants fled. Neighbours, hearing the screams, informed the police. Salim was taken to a nearby hospital, from where he was referred to Guru Tegh Bahadur Hospital (GTB) in Delhi. His condition remains serious. Son Usman had filed a complaint with the police. It is named Ashfaq, Sonu, Shahrukh Neta, Bhati Builder, and a local AIMIM leader, Azgar. The FIR mentioned 2 unknown persons. It was alleged that these people had conspired to murder his father Salim.
